title: tests.yml stops running on tags: a release's CI verdict is its candidate's run (0087's follow-up)
body:
## What

Since issue 0087 a release's CI verdict is the run on `candidate/<tag>`, which devbin's release core reads before it tags. `tests.yml` still runs on a tag push too, so every cut runs the Linux and macOS jobs a second time once the verdict is in, and nothing reads that run. pplr's workflow has no tag trigger. pplr-vc named dropping it as a follow-up for 1.4.3 in 0087's note.

hv, 4 Nov 2026, in molt-dc's session: go, for Molt 1.4.3. That retires the tag filter hv set for the fleet on 22 Sep 2026 from this workflow.

## Next

1. `tests.yml`: no `tags:` under `push`; test-macos's `if:` and Test Summary's `MACOS_REQUIRED` keep a candidate and a dispatch, without the tag case; the comments that explain the tag filter and a tag's own concurrency group follow.
2. The workflow README, `intent/llm/RULES.md` and `intent/llm/ARCHITECTURE.md` say where macOS runs now: a candidate and a dispatch.
3. Proof: `bin/devbin ci-state --fires` reads a candidate push as firing at the change, and the workflow parses. dc builds it on a branch; vc merges; the CHANGELOG line goes under 1.4.3.
